brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, wide 16:9 landscape, ideally 1600x900 or larger, PNG, opaque.
This is a pregame preview for the fixed article dated 2026.10.31, NOT a depiction of a verified actual game or result.

STYLE: Match the already viewed approved black/lime basketball thumbnail: deep almost-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory lettering, hand-drawn ink contours, dry-brush swipes and sparse ink flecks, print-editorial illustration. Very bold readable Japanese gothic headlines. Restrained elements, sophisticated sports editorial, not photorealism, not anime, not a photographic collage. Faces must be clearly drawn but recognizably based on the two real players described below.

SUBJECTS: Exactly TWO real players, Reoto Yonesu (米須玲音) and Narito Namizato (並里成), chosen because both are the article's protagonists. The official 2026-27 portraits shown in the conversation are identity references ONLY, never paste the photographs into the image.
Yonesu official appearance reference: https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/727/2026-27/5100000022_03.png . Young clean-shaven man with short straight black hair swept slightly to the side, short neat sides, softly oval face tapering to chin, dark eyes, straight dark brows, relatively full lips. Light natural skin, slender athletic guard. Draw him in a plain dark burgundy basketball kit with ivory edge trim, absolutely no logos, sponsor text, team symbols or jersey numbers.
Namizato official appearance reference: https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/694/2026-27/9489_03.png . Short wavy/curly hair with dark roots and blond/light-brown tips and a slightly parted irregular top, strong dark eyebrows, tan skin, pronounced cheekbones, narrower chin, thin mustache and small separated chin beard/goatee, no full beard. Compact muscular guard. Draw him in a plain navy basketball kit with subtle red and white edge trim, absolutely no logos, sponsor text, team symbols or jersey numbers.
Do not substitute fictional athletes, celebrities, or the players from the approved style samples. Do not use Namizato's older bleached buzz cut from the 2025 portrait; use the current short highlighted curls.

COMPOSITION: A bold symmetrical editorial confrontation with movement: Yonesu on the left third in a low forward dribbling drive, body and eyes oriented toward the center/right, hand visibly controlling ONE orange basketball at hip/lower torso height. Namizato on the right third in a low defensive side-step with one open hand extending toward the ball and the other naturally balanced, oriented toward the center/left. Both faces clearly visible in three-quarter view, large enough to identify. Show from approximately mid-thigh upward, intentional lower-body framing, whole heads and all hands/ball contained inside the canvas, no awkward joint cropping. Natural limb proportions, five anatomically sensible fingers per visible hand, no merging arms.
The central area carries the typography, with clear spacing from the faces and hands. The players are original illustrative poses expressing a possible matchup, not a reconstruction of an actual play. Sparse diagonal lime strokes behind figures suggest motion. Keep typography over clean dark negative space and do not put text over faces.

EXACT TEXT, no other writing:
Small top-left masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
Small top-right date and clear context badge: 「2026.10.31」 and 「試合前プレビュー」
The central dominant title split into two large lines: 「神奈川」 / 「ダービー」
Below in clear ivory: 「川崎 × 横浜BC」
Below in bold lime or ivory: 「司令塔対決」
Small player labels directly below their own portrait: LEFT 「米須玲音」, RIGHT 「並里成」
Clear full-width footer qualifier in ivory: 「記事時点：出場未確認」
Bottom credit text fully readable: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

CONTENT LIMITS: The fixed article does not verify either player's participation. Preserve the pregame and unconfirmed-participation wording visibly. No scores, performance statistics, win predictions, game result, captain claims, start time, arena details, awards, official seals, other player names, watermarks, or tiny filler text. Do not carry over 38 points, 24 points or other text from style samples. Keep enough margins that all Japanese glyphs, footer and credit remain fully visible. Render Japanese text accurately as written, especially 米須玲音, 並里成, 神奈川, 出場未確認 and イラスト（AI生成）.

--- ONE ALLOWED REVISION ---

Use case: identity-preserve.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the finished 16:9 Japanese black/lime basketball thumbnail. Images 2 and 3 are identity references ONLY: official portraits of Reoto Yonesu (left player, image 2) and Narito Namizato (right player, image 3). Do not paste the photos or their logos into the output.
Make ONLY one targeted refinement: improve the likeness of both illustrated players' FACES AND HAIR to the respective official portraits while maintaining the target's hand-drawn ink / dry-brush illustration style. Keep everything else unchanged, including the canvas size, composition, all poses, the single basketball, hands and fingers, kits without logos/numbers, colors, text and text placement.
LEFT Yonesu: match image 2's short black hair and compact neat sides, the slightly side-swept top without long bangs, rounder open eyes, dark brows, softer oval cheeks/jaw tapering to a neat chin, clean-shaven. His face in the target is somewhat too sharp/angular; make it recognizably the real player's softer features. Keep the focused playing expression and current three-quarter head orientation; do not copy the portrait smile.
RIGHT Namizato: match image 3's actual cheek and eye shapes, mature facial structure, short highlighted curls with dark roots, thin mustache and small chin beard. Retain focused playing expression and head orientation. No full beard.
Preserve ALL exact existing Japanese text in image 1, including 「バスケまとめ」「2026.10.31」「試合前プレビュー」「神奈川」「ダービー」「川崎 × 横浜BC」「司令塔対決」「米須玲音」「並里成」「記事時点：出場未確認」「イラスト（AI生成）」「イメージ」. Do not introduce new words or numbers. This is a pregame illustrative concept, not an actual game reconstruction.
No photography, no photographic faces, no logo, no sponsor text, no league mark, no jersey numbers, no additional figures. Output exactly ONE complete PNG thumbnail, same landscape aspect ratio.
